description: Dagster connector (read-only). Surfaces the user's data-orchestration jobs from a Dagster Cloud deployment or a self-hosted Dagster OSS instance as dagster:job items in the local index — each job's name, repository, code location, description, isJob flag, and tags. Useful for answering orchestration questions ("which jobs live in the analytics repository?", "what tags does the nightly job carry?") without leaving Nimbus. Dagster exposes a single GraphQL endpoint at <base_url>/graphql; auth is the Dagster-Cloud-Api-Token header (required for Dagster Cloud; self-hosted OSS users may set any non-empty placeholder). Dagster has no universal SaaS host: the per-tenant host root is supplied via the dagster base_url vault key and added to the sandbox network list at spawn time by phase3AddDagsterMcp, so the static manifest network list is intentionally empty. The list query walks the repositories→jobs catalog (repositoriesOrError → nodes[].pipelines[]) in one response and flattens to jobs, capturing each job's repository + location; a PythonError typename or a top-level GraphQL errors array degrades gracefully. v1 indexes jobs only — runs and assets are a deferred follow-up. No write tools.
author: Nimbus
